notes: v17 DEVICE-EVIDENCE FIXES — wo masle jo aap ke phone par pakke saboot ke saath mile: (1) BARA DIMAGH KA MODEL: purana model (gemini-2.0-flash) Google ne is key ke liye band kar diya tha — is liye test 'model nahi mila' kehta tha, halanke aap ki key theek thi. Ab Dost ke paas 4 models ki chain hai (gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-flash-latest, gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite): ek model band ho jaye to Dost khud agle par chala jata hai, aur jo model jawab de, wo Settings ki 'Bara Dimagh ki halat' mein dikhta bhi hai. Settings se 'Bara Dimagh test karein' dobara dabayein — ab jawab aana chahiye. (2) AWAAZ: mic ki khamoshi wala nizam ab Dost ke BOLTE waqt dobara mute nahi lagata — pehle jawab aksar isi liye aadhe sunai dete ya ghayab ho jate the. Aur ek hi kharabi wala card ab baar baar nahi ayega. (3) GRID: 'grid dikhao' dobara bolne se grid band ho jayega (pehle wo wahin atka rehta tha); 'grid band karo' / 'grid hatao' bhi chalega; koi aur command chale to grid khud peeche hat jayega; Dost ki apni screen khule to bhi grid band ho jayega. (4) TASK: ab 'kya task hain', 'task batao', 'aaj ke task', 'mere task' aur Urdu script mein likha command bhi chalta hai. Permissions bilkul wahi 16 — koi nayi permission nahi.
